decisions.title: Central Avenue and Zuni Road Cross-Section Modification Analysis
decisions.description: Tests proposed lane reductions, bicycle lanes, medians, pedestrian refuges, turn-lane changes, signal timing, and 2035 traffic conditions on Zuni Road and Central Avenue, finding the Zuni configuration operationally feasible with targeted intersection mitigations while deferring Central changes pending BRT analysis.
processing_notes: Original authoritative PDF preserved without modification.
Complete extracted text reviewed; first, middle, and final pages visually inspected.
